name: Easy Web Accessibility by Wawsome
author: Wawsome

sections.installation:
1. Add the Wawsome plugin to your WordPress site.
  2. Access your website’s admin dashboard.
  3. Navigate to the “Plugins” section.
  4. Find and activate the “Wawsome WCAG Accessibility” plugin.
  5. Complete the setup by signing up on the Settings → Wawsome page.
sections.faq:
What AI processes does Wawsome use?

Wawsome leverages AI to enhance accessibility through automated image descriptions, dynamic ARIA labeling for improved navigation, and personalized adjustments based on user behavior and the context of the elements inside your website. These processes ensure that all users have a smoother experience navigating your website.

Can Wawsome enable users with disabilities to use my website?

Yes! Wawsome is designed to empower users with disabilities by enhancing your website’s accessibility. It helps address common challenges in vision, hearing, motor, and cognitive accessibility, making your site more inclusive for all users.

Is there anything Wawsome does not address?

While Wawsome covers most web accessibility needs, it does not automatically address video, PDF, or SVG content. These elements require manual adjustments to meet accessibility standards fully.

How does Wawsome differ from other web accessibility plugins?

Most free plugins cover only 15%-20% of accessibility requirements based on EAA standards. Wawsome, on the other hand, is Europe’s leading solution built from the ground up around WCAG standards, providing a more comprehensive and compliant accessibility solution for your website.

What disability categories does Wawsome support?

Wawsome adheres to the WCAG 2.1 AA Rating, which covers a wide range of accessibility needs, including vision, hearing, motor, cognitive, and other disabilities, helping your site meet regulatory and practical standards for inclusivity.

How does Wawsome help make your website more accessible?

Once installed, Wawsome scans your website’s code to detect accessibility issues. It then applies real-time adjustments through the website widget, to enhance compliance with Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG), making your website more inclusive for all users.

Can I try Wawsome for free?

Yes! Wawsome offers a 7-day free trial so you can explore its features before committing to a plan.

How much does Wawsome cost?

Wawsome’s pricing is based on your website’s traffic, with plans starting from as low as €23.75 per month.

sections.description:
Make your website accessible and inclusive with Wawsome’s intelligent accessibility and compliance solution.

Web Accessibility Made Easy with Wawsome

Making your website accessible can seem challenging, but Wawsome simplifies the process. Our AI-powered accessibility widget helps your site achieve compliance with WCAG 2.1 Level AA, the European Accessibility Act (EAA), and other global standards. With Wawsome, creating an inclusive digital experience for users with disabilities has never been easier.

Try Wawsome Risk-Free

Explore Wawsome with a 7-day free trial. See how effortless accessibility can be for your website.

How Wawsome Works

Wawsome scans your website to identify accessibility issues and provides smart, AI-driven modifications that make your site more inclusive. From adding image descriptions to improving keyboard navigation, Wawsome ensures your site is accessible to all users without changing your source code.

Comprehensive Accessibility Features

Predefined accessibility profiles for different disabilities, including vision impairment, dyslexia, ADHD, and more.
Customizable text adjustments, such as font size, spacing, and alignment, to suit individual user needs.
Dynamic color and contrast settings to enhance visibility for users with visual impairments.
A robust text-to-speech feature for users relying on screen readers.
Monthly accessibility reports and compliance monitoring to keep your site updated.

Why Choose Wawsome?

– Ensure Compliance: Align with WCAG 2.1 standards and avoid legal risks tied to accessibility regulations like the EAA.
– Expand Your Audience: An accessible site opens the door to millions of potential users with disabilities, a market with significant purchasing power.
– Protect Against Lawsuits: Achieve compliance and shield your business from accessibility-related legal actions.
– Enhance SEO and Brand Reputation: Accessibility improves user experience and boosts SEO rankings, showing your commitment to inclusivity.

Quick and Easy to Use

Wawsome is simple to install and works seamlessly with your WordPress website. It continuously scans for new issues, ensuring ongoing accessibility compliance without requiring manual intervention.

Customizable User Experience

Wawsome empowers your visitors by providing an intuitive interface to personalize their browsing experience. From adjusting colors and fonts to enabling reading guides, Wawsome makes every visitor feel at home on your website.

Start Your Accessibility Journey Today

Try Wawsome risk-free for 7 days and discover how effortless accessibility can transform your website into an inclusive, compliant, and welcoming digital space.

External Services

This plugin relies on an external service provided by Wawsome (dashboard.wawsome.com) to handle user registration, subscription management, and the configuration of the accessibility widget. The external service is used for the following purposes:

• Dashboard & Onboarding:
When the plugin’s admin page is loaded, it displays a button that links to an external dashboard (at https://dashboard.wawsome.com/plugin-config). This dashboard allows administrators to create or log into their Wawsome account, configure widget settings, and manage subscriptions.

• Data Transmission:
The plugin automatically sends the following data to the external service:
– The storefront URL (siteUrl)
– The locale code (lang)
– A redirect URL (redirectUrl) to return to your admin panel after certain actions
– The API key (apiKey), which is generated after successful registration on Wawsome

These data elements are transmitted when the user clicks the “Connect to Wawsome Dashboard” button from the Admin page. No personal data beyond these configuration parameters is sent.

• Usage Conditions:
The external service is used solely to provide the backend functionality for configuring and managing the accessibility widget, processing subscriptions, and distributing the API key. The service is essential for the operation of the plugin and is provided by Wawsome.

For additional details on how your data is handled by the external service, please review the following:
• Wawsome Terms of Service
• Wawsome Privacy Policy

By using this plugin, you acknowledge and agree that your data (as described above) will be transmitted to and processed by the Wawsome external service.
